limits: One M5 Pro/macOS27.2 and one fixed 8s generated code/motion cycle. Fresh independent encoder processes; not independent content/devices. No statistical CI, controlled thermal/power, app/viewer/helpers/GPU/physical footprint/actual wire/relay or codec admission. Callback latency excludes source read/fill; CPU/RSS include I/O/init/warmup. Per-run p95 distributions are retained separately.
